name: save-boot-20c-world-menu-state
description: #226 attempt 2 diagnostic: what one Triangle press does on the world map. Load disc1-wm1-kalm and close the entry window as save-boot-20a does, then one Triangle press (4 frames) and 120 frames still. Reported at the end: g_GameState (game_state: 5 if the menu module took over), the world loop state (wl_state: 2 if the menu runs inside the world loop), window 0's state (win0), the world button flag (btn_ok: 1 if the pad is live), the main-menu cursor (row0) and the menu overlay id (menu_ovl). match: a rerun from the same snapshot. Only numbers leave.
